prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: concussion. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1042; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following side impact at intersection. Insured reports the other vehicle entered the intersection against signal. Police report requested. Vehicle inspection scheduled. Claimant reports concussion symptoms and has retained counsel; all further contact to go through attorney's office.

Entry 2: Police report received. Responding officer documented right-angle collision with damage to driver-side door and rear quarter panel of insured vehicle. Witness statement obtained from pedestrian at corner, supports insured's account of green signal. Liability analysis in progress. Photos of both vehicles uploaded to file.

Entry 3: Spoke with claimant's attorney by phone. Counsel confirmed client was treated at urgent care and diagnosed with concussion. Requested medical authorization forms and full records. Advised that bodily injury evaluation will not proceed until records are received. Attorney indicated demand package will follow.

Entry 4: Independent appraiser completed inspection of insured vehicle. Estimate lists structural repair to driver-side frame rail, door replacement, and sensor recalibration. Total loss threshold not met. Repair authorized pending supervisor review. Rental coverage confirmed for duration of repairs.

Entry 5: Received medical records from claimant's treating physician. Records document concussion diagnosis, follow-up neurology referral, and a recommended period of reduced activity. File referred to bodily injury unit for evaluation. Reserve review requested. Next step is to await demand from counsel and confirm liability percentage before settlement discussions.
